_about: Variant 1. Quests are authored decision graphs (D&D-style choices with visible odds). Two samples. A linter checks: every node reachable from start; every non-terminal has >= 2 choices; every terminal is an authored ending with effects; every effect names a real quantity; every check names a stat and a dc. Language models help write quest text at build time only; the shipped graph is fixed data.

nodes.text: Sadruba: 'Ophel keeps a wax tablet of every Pit habit in the camp. Ours too. Bring it, or break it.'

choices.label: Slip into the Tide Tent at the evening bell
Buy a look at it from Nysa
Refuse: 'I win in the arena, not in their tent.'

nodes.text: Doros sits by the tablet chest, counting bread.

choices.label: Wait for the change of watch

nodes.text: Nysa smiles. 'A look costs ten. Keeping quiet about who looked costs more.'
Salt crackles at the tent flap. The Vigil is near.

choices.label: Bluff: you came to see Doros

terminals.text: You read half the tablet before she takes it back.
The lines blur. You remember little but the price.
You leave with nothing and no one saw your face.
Warden Septima's salt burns your wrists.

quests.title: Bread for the Ditch
quests.window: while the strays situation is huddled or desperate

nodes.text: Fenna: 'The Granary sweeps the floor at dusk. The sweepings go to the pigs the Romans do not let us see. Help me get them first.'

choices.label: Work a shift and pay for bread honestly
Tell her to ask her own tent

nodes.text: The keeper turns. Fenna is still inside.

terminals.text: Two sacks of sweepings and a grin.
The Vigil fines you; Fenna remembers.
Fenna is pinned for the theft.
